coverage_summary: Global scan covered infrastructure, energy and Gulf logistics, trade and U.S.-China technology/rare-earth policy, monetary and capital access, frontier local-currency debt benchmarking, production, AI deployment, labour and institutions. Material developments were either already represented by existing structural mechanisms, remained announcements/planned changes without demonstrated operation or scale, or did not yet change accessibility, confidence or transition path enough to justify a staged Atlas candidate. JPMorgan's planned GBI-EM Edge index was noted as a prospective capital-access change but is not yet operational; U.S.-China weekend talks are a catalyst rather than a verified rule change; Saudi export workarounds remain operational adaptations whose durable scale is not yet established.
